load_alignments_from_npz: load bitext alignments from an NPZ file and filter by score range
filter_and_sort_alignments: filter alignments by score range and sort by descending score
save_bitext_texts_to_tsv: save mined bitext pairs with scores to TSV files with optional deduplication
load_source_target_data: load source and target text lines by index from parallel text files
check_alignments_has_meta: check if the alignments object has source and target metadata loaded
